title: Gift bag
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='bag' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#ff5f8f'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#c2185b'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='side' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='0'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#d81b60'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#8e0f45'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='handle' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#ffe082'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#f9a825'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- handles -->
  <path d='M34 38 C34 18 66 18 66 38' fill='none' stroke='#f9a825' stroke-width='6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M34 38 C34 20 66 20 66 38' fill='none' stroke='#ffe082' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- bag body -->
  <path d='M22 38 L78 38 L72 92 L28 92 Z' fill='url(#bag)'/>
  <!-- side shading -->
  <path d='M22 38 L78 38 L72 92 L28 92 Z' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M60 38 L78 38 L72 92 L58 92 Z' fill='url(#side)' opacity='0.75'/>

  <!-- top fold / rim -->
  <rect x='20' y='34' width='60' height='9' rx='3' fill='#ff8fb0'/>
  <rect x='20' y='34' width='60' height='3.5' rx='1.7' fill='#ffb3c8'/>

  <!-- vertical stripes for cuteness -->
  <rect x='38' y='44' width='4' height='46' rx='2' fill='#ffd54f' opacity='0.9'/>
  <rect x='52' y='44' width='4' height='46' rx='2' fill='#ffd54f' opacity='0.9'/>

  <!-- bow -->
  <path d='M50 34 C42 24 34 26 36 32 C37.5 36 44 36 50 34 Z' fill='#ffe082'/>
  <path d='M50 34 C58 24 66 26 64 32 C62.5 36 56 36 50 34 Z' fill='#ffe082'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='34' r='4.5' fill='#f9a825'/>
  <circle cx='48.5' cy='32.5' r='1.5' fill='#fff3c4'/>

  <!-- little tag -->
  <path d='M70 42 L82 46 L80 54 L68 50 Z' fill='#7ee0d5'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='44' r='1.8' fill='#2f8f86'/>
</svg>
